description: We are Star Astronauts from Yonkers, New York. We are telling a story about how to inhabit Mars and a means to get there.
summary:
Mars is the fourth planet from the sun. Mars is similar to the Earth and is also known as the Red Planet. Land rovers have discovered rounded pebbles and clay minerals that show that Mars once had flowing water bodies. Mars has two moons called Phobos and Deimos. The moon is the natural satellite of the Earth. Discoveries show that the moon once had a global magma ocean.

details: Our project is about the moon and Mars and their discoveries. This project adopts a storytelling model to explain the scientific missions to the moon and Mars. This project seeks to explain to beginners the technologies involved in these missions and some important findings.
